About the store

Rooted in Dayalpura Farm

Daas Foods sits right on NH-44 near Basantpura, opposite AGM Resort — a straightforward, farm-rooted organic grocery for the neighbourhood and for travellers passing through on the highway.

The idea is simple: everyday food shouldn't come with a long list of things to worry about. So the shelves here stay close to their source, favouring organic growing over shortcuts.

If you're driving NH-44 through Rajpura and want to bring something honest home, it's worth the stop.

Inside the store

What you'll find on the shelves

An everyday organic grocery selection — ask in-store for what's freshest this week.

Grains & pulses

Everyday staples like rice, wheat flour, and lentils, sourced organically.

Cold-pressed oils

Traditionally extracted oils and ghee, made without shortcuts.

Seasonal produce

Fruits and vegetables picked to the season, not flown in from far away.

Spices & masalas

Ground and whole spices, kept close to how they'd be made at home.

Dairy essentials

Milk, ghee, and paneer from sources the store trusts.

Farm staples

Jaggery, honey, and other basics sourced straight from local farms.
